name: Critical Study (Ex)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A slayer that selects this talent adds his studied target bonus to the saving throw DC of the Stunning Fist feat and all critical feats that he possesses.
